translation.name: Nzryrngrkxtr Kc Ate Rut x Sam

content: Namnclzbzku Mz Yawe, King Kc Tqngi Kxrpalz

content.text: Nangrbzku mz Yawe mz nzabrtzngr.
Murde nide butqbr kc tqrlakitrku.
Na-awibzku bade
Mz nzngr-kato-krbzku bade mz nabz kxyrlvi!
Murde Yawe nide Gct kc tqmyalz-esz'ngr,
X King kc tqmyaszlzle kxnzmncng mzlilxlr amrlx.
Me boongr yc mz mqde.
X nyz-kzde newz kxmyalzng.
Prla x drtc' nyzdeng
Murde wz-ngrde mz nzngini-krde Kxrpalz.
Na-angioku Yawe kc tqwz-ngrde nigu
Mz nzyrngzlvzo-krgu nide.
Murde nide Gct rgu, x nigu leplz nedeng,
Apuku sip kx aclveleng.
X naxlramu natqde mzbq ka,
Mz nzrpi-krbzle bamu kx,
“Bzkq nabzmu mqngipe, da kc tzwailr melrmqmung.
Murde kxmule-esz' nzmc-zvzlr nzrkati-krbo da kxmrlzting badr,
Mz nzmnc-krdr mrkc lzke, a' otablrkr badr mrkc Meriba,
X nzatalzlr ninge mrkc Masa, mz nzxpqbrlr-krdr ninge.
Mz yiz lcng nzpnu-pwx ngyati zvz ngr drtwrnge nidr.
Murde nidr leplz kx nzvz-rbrng mz nabzdr x trnzvz-nqblqlru nqmq krngeng.
X mz nzangya-krmlr drtwrnge, sc tqesalzpex kx,
Trtxpnzngr nzprtr-krdr mz nzmnc-zpwxngr kc nakabo badr.”
